entries.mechanism: The Axiom leg evaluates the fixtures' completed Rhode Island taxable income, which deducts $350 (single) / $700 (married) more than PolicyEngine's 2026-projected standard deduction plus exemption ($10,900 + $5,200 single); the residual is exactly that gap at each case's bracket rates. Rhode Island's official 2026 indexed amounts are not yet reflected by either side. Actionable upstream: regenerate the rulespec-us companion fixtures via the encoder once official 2026 amounts publish; not fixable in this repo.

Parameter uprating vintage between the legs: the axiom program carries
FY2026-uprated RI parameters while the oracle leg's parameter set holds
the prior vintage, producing income-invariant flat deltas within each
filing band (the fingerprint: identical differences across the grid's
income levels — e.g. Washington's flat \$163.92 equals the 7 percent
rate times the \$2,342 capital-gains standard-deduction vintage gap, PE
278,000 vs axiom's uprated value). Favors the encoded 2026 truth;
resolves when the oracle's parameters uprate.
